question: May this consumer land before the matching ClawHub producer is merged and deployed, or must both sides and live Control proof be ready together?
rationale: Source tests can validate fallback and trust logic, but only maintainers can choose the cross-repository rollout order and accept or reject the period where the consumer contract is unproven against the deployed producer.

options.title: Wait for producer proof
options.body: Merge and deploy the ClawHub producer first, capture real Control catalog evidence for hosted and local fallback cases, then land this PR.

options.title: Land consumer first
options.body: Accept an initially inert consumer change and require post-deploy verification before including the behavior in a release.

recommendation.title: Wait for producer proof
recommendation.body: Merge and deploy the ClawHub producer first, capture real Control catalog evidence for hosted and local fallback cases, then land this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to managed plugin and ClawHub/npm authority behavior on the consumer side.
